features.name: GitHub actions referenced by commit SHA
features.description: AL Go for GitHub now references non-AL Go GitHub actions using commit SHA instead of tags or branches for enhanced security.
caveats: AL Go actions still use version numbers like 5.3 to allow hotfixes

features.name: Pre-commit for file consistency
features.description: Pre-commit has been added to ensure consistency of markdown files and other files for general file housekeeping in AL Go for GitHub repositories.

features.name: Federated credentials and managed identities
features.description: AL Go for GitHub now supports federated credentials and managed identities to eliminate the need for secrets in authentication to resources like key vaults and Business Central.
caveats: Tenant ID and client ID are still stored in secrets template for implementation reasons
Access tokens remain valid for typically one hour if exposed

features.name: NuGet support for AppSource apps
features.description: Symbols for all AppSource apps are now available on a public NuGet feed. AL Go for GitHub supports trusting both private and public NuGet feeds with options to register prefixes and fingerprints for security.
caveats: Normally you should not trust nuget.org unless you have registered prefixes or fingerprints
Federated credentials not yet supported

features.name: Deliver to NuGet implementation changes
features.description: NuGet delivery implementation has been updated to use the same mechanism as GitHub packages, with each app having one package instead of collecting apps and dependencies into one NuGet package.
caveats: Each app must be its own package
Full dependency tree required in full app packages

features.name: Runtime packages publishing to NuGet
features.description: Future capability to publish runtime packages to NuGet as either private or public feeds, allowing sharing with partners or customers.
features.status_evidence_quote: As future investments, we will also be able to publish runtime packages to NuGet, either private or public
caveats: Not yet available
Still in future investments phase

features.name: First-party apps in NuGet packages
features.description: Future capability to make all Microsoft first-party apps available in NuGet packages along with app source symbols.
features.status_evidence_quote: we're also working on having all first-party apps, meaning all Microsoft apps, available in NuGet packages as well as the app source symbols.

features.name: Trusted NuGet feeds in AL Go for GitHub
features.description: Configuration to add trusted NuGet servers in AL Go for GitHub settings. Microsoft-provided AppSource symbols NuGet feeds are automatically trusted by default.
caveats: Federated credentials not yet supported for auth tokens
URL must be known for non-default feeds

features.name: NuGet feed fingerprint and prefix registration
features.description: Ability to register package prefixes and fingerprints with NuGet feeds to ensure you are only trusting specific packages or certificate-signed packages.

features.name: GitHub packages naming changes
features.description: Small change to GitHub packages naming format from AL Go app ID to app name and app ID to better reflect the package identity.
caveats: Existing users will see name changes
Package resolution still uses app ID

features.name: Performance test in AL Go for GitHub
features.description: New capability to run performance tests in CI/CD or scheduled test runs with baseline comparison, regression detection, and configurable thresholds for duration and SQL statement counts.
caveats: Requires manual baseline setup or copy from prior runs

features.name: Performance test threshold configuration
features.description: Configurable thresholds for performance test regression warnings and errors based on duration percentage and SQL statement counts, with separate thresholds for warnings and failures.
caveats: SQL statement regression often primary cause of performance issues

features.name: BC samples GitHub tag
features.description: GitHub tag and centralized list of Business Central sample repositories that can be discovered at aka.ms/bcsamples. Currently includes repositories showcasing Power Platform integration, onboarding approaches, and Bing Maps implementations.
caveats: Currently only Microsoft repositories shown initially
Community samples can be added by tagging with BC samples topic

features.name: BC samples repository forking and setup
features.description: Ability to fork BC sample repositories to get complete AL Go for GitHub setup and Power Platform integration for local development and testing.

features.name: BC Container Helper deprecation in AL Go
features.description: AL Go for GitHub will gradually stop using BC Container Helper and move DevOps-relevant features to other PowerShell modules and GitHub Actions instead. BC Container Helper will remain available but eventually lose support as platform requirements evolve.
caveats: Transition planned over 2 to 3 years
Users of self-made DevOps solutions will need to migrate
New PowerShell module commands will not be compatible with BC Container Helper
Eventually BC Container Helper will no longer be supported

features.name: Managed DevOps solutions strategy
features.description: Recommends using managed DevOps solutions like Azure DevOps tasks (ALOps), AL Go for GitHub, or Cosmo Alpaca instead of self-made DevOps pipelines. These solutions automatically handle updates when new Business Central versions are released.

features.name: Page scripting tests in AL Go CI/CD
features.description: Support for running page scripting tests directly in CI/CD pipelines as part of test current, test next minor, and test next major workflows. The BC replay NPM package was recently released publicly to enable this capability.
caveats: Not yet implemented in AL Go
ALOps already offers this capability

features.name: Indirect template customization capabilities
features.description: Partners will be able to customize AL Go templates beyond what comes out of the box, with the ability to add custom scripts, steps, and jobs while remaining current with latest versions.
features.status_evidence_quote: We're working on indirect tape templates and customization capabilities, and we're not really sure where to land this one.
caveats: Decision point on scope of customization not yet finalized
Need to clearly document customization boundaries

features.name: Runtime package generation and NuGet publishing
features.description: Future capability to generate and publish runtime packages to NuGet for apps with AppSource or local dependencies only, using symbols of AppSource apps and a small addition to the AL compiler.
features.status_evidence_quote: We also will add mechanisms to generate and publish runtime packages to NuGet. We've talked about this for quite some time. Now we have
caveats: Requires additional AL compiler functionality
Applies only to apps with AppSource or local dependencies

features.name: Enhanced documentation and roadmap for AL Go
features.description: Plans to add more documentation, how-to videos, and an updated roadmap for AL Go for GitHub to make it easier for partners and customers to use.
features.status_evidence_quote: We'll add some more documentation, more how-to videos, and an updated roadmap so that this will make life easier for partners and customers using
